en-US.name: Contract Review Team
en-US.summary: Six-member contract review team with parallel risk and jurisdiction checks, independent re-verification, scored reporting, and tracked DOCX delivery. Requires a user-configured model service; verify the route and availability before calling it. Contract text and attachments are sent for analysis. Qualified human review is required; provider terms and separate costs are the user's responsibility. If unavailable, stop external calls and produce only a bounded report.
en-US.description: Six members collaborate through stable, observable steps: input coverage, source evidence, real receipts, independent re-verification, and explicit gaps. The Lead fans out jurisdiction and risk checks in parallel, then produces a scored report and tracked DOCX. Contract text and attachments are sent to the user-configured model service for analysis; before any external call, confirm the configured provider/model route and service availability. If the service is unavailable, stop before calling it and produce only a capability_debt/blocked bounded report; never fabricate legal findings. Qualified human review is required before using the outputs. Provider terms and any separate service costs are the user's responsibility. Members initially appear collapsed under the supervisor; an explicit user choice of flat or nested display takes precedence.

zh-CN.name: 合同审查团队
zh-CN.summary: 六名成员协作完成风险与法域并行、独立复核、评分报告和带修订 DOCX 交付。需要用户配置模型服务，调用前须确认模型路由和服务可用；合同正文与附件会发送用于分析，结果须由具备资质的人员复核，服务条款与额外费用由用户负责，服务不可用时停止外部调用并只生成范围受限报告。
zh-CN.description: 六名成员按固定且可观察的步骤协作：文件覆盖、原文证据、真实回执、独立复核和明确欠账。Lead 将法域与风险检查真正并行，再生成评分报告和带修订 DOCX。合同正文与附件会发送到用户配置的模型服务用于分析；调用前必须确认 provider/model 路由与服务可用性，不可用时停止并只生成 capability_debt/blocked 的范围受限报告，不得伪造法律结论。使用前必须由具备资质的人员复核，服务条款与额外费用由用户负责。成员默认收纳在组长下方并初始收起；用户显式选择平铺或收纳时，以用户选择为准。

requirements.value: Requires DesireCore 10.0.178 or newer with support for team.json memberDisplay. Stable 10.0.177 does not support this manifest field. This catalog release is published ahead of the compatible client; older clients must upgrade before installation.

Before any call, confirm the configured provider/model route and service availability. Contract text and attachments are sent to that service; if unavailable, stop and emit only a capability_debt/blocked bounded report, never a fabricated legal result.
Qualified human review is required before using the scored report or tracked DOCX. Provider terms and any separate service costs remain the user's responsibility.
